entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2.

The applicant has preferred instant application for grant of bail in Case Crime No.248 of 2023,
under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 & 120B IPC, Police Station Noida Sector-20, District Gautam Budh Nagar during pendency of the trial before the court below.

entities.text: Police Station Noida Sector-20, District Gautam Budh Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant has adopted the arguments advanced by learned counsel for other accused persons in bunch of bail applications decided with Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 53010 of 2023, (Rajiv Jindal v. State of U.P.).

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 53010 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text: Rajiv Jindal v. State of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Apart from the aforesaid, learned counsel for the applicant submits that in relation to same offence, co-accused Rajiv Jindal has already been released on bail by the Apex Court vide order dated 25.10.2024, however, he does not dispute that the applicant's case is also covered by the case of co-accused Rajiv Jindal.

1 4.

entities.text: Amit Alias Moti Alias Motu vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: While deciding the matter of other accused persons on same issue, in the aforesaid bunch of bail applications, this Court has passed a detailed order on 31.08.2024 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 53010 of 2023, (Rajiv Jindal v. State of U.P.), whereby bail applications have been rejected.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 53010 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text: Rajiv Jindal v. State of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned A.G.A. submits that case of the applicant is squarely covered with the applicants in Rajiv Jindal (supra).
6. In view of the reasons recorded in the order dated 31.08.2024 passed in Rajiv Jindal (supra), this Court is of the considered view that the applicant is not entitled for bail.
7. Accordingly, the bail application stands rejected.
